metadata.title: PuzzleMask Evidence Provenance Graph
metadata.description: Traceable provenance from the PuzzleMask source claim through agent action, telemetry, correlation, validation, and MITRE ATT&CK mapping. This is the 'why do we believe it' view -- see action-provenance-finance-agent.json for the 'what happened' view.
metadata.statusReason: The report summary says ready to deploy, but the detection body explicitly marks three placeholders and says the rule is not deploy-ready until they are completed.

nodes.label: PuzzleMask detection report
nodes.description: Detection Proposal Report - PuzzleMask: Abusing Plain Prose as a Covert AI Attack Vector.
evidence: Source file: detection_report (1).md
One behavior cluster and one proposed detection

nodes.label: Gatekeeper evasion (BC-1)
nodes.description: Adversarial prompt text is crafted to evade policy screening so unsafe instructions reach a downstream model or tool-enabled agent.
evidence: Kill-chain phase: Defense Evasion
Choke point: attack action
Variants: encoding, surface, parameter

nodes.label: Submit disguised prompt
nodes.description: An account submits policy-violating instructions hidden in ordinary prose.
evidence: Prompt content is projected as InputParameters
No exact prompt examples were supplied by the source

nodes.label: Policy gatekeeper
nodes.description: The lightweight content-safety or policy-screening control that PuzzleMask attempts to bypass.
evidence: No explicit gatekeeper decision field was confirmed

nodes.label: Complete Sentinel AI tool run
nodes.description: The downstream AI or tool-enabled workflow completes after receiving input.
evidence: ActionType == SentinelAIToolRunCompleted

nodes.label: Account
nodes.description: The primary entity used to attribute and correlate the AI tool run with downstream alert evidence.
evidence: Join key: AccountObjectId
Projected context: AccountUpn, AccountDisplayName, AccountId

nodes.label: Application and source IP
nodes.description: Cloud application and network context used during analyst triage.
evidence: Entity fields: Application, ApplicationId, IPAddress

nodes.label: CloudAppEvents
nodes.description: Records the completed Sentinel AI tool run and its input, tools, APIs, tables, and databases.
evidence: Must-have columns: Timestamp, ActionType, AccountObjectId, RawEventData, ReportId
Lookup ingestion window: 5h

nodes.label: AlertEvidence
nodes.description: Provides later security evidence for the same account to corroborate downstream impact.
evidence: Must-have columns: Timestamp, AlertId, Title, Categories, AccountObjectId, ServiceSource, DetectionSource, Severity
Scheduled ingestion window: 1h

nodes.label: Entra Agent ID chain
nodes.description: The official Microsoft Entra identity model for AI agents: an agent identity blueprint (template/app registration) is used to create an agent identity blueprint principal, which issues agent identities (service principal instances), optionally paired with an agent's user account.
evidence: Sentinel schema browser tables: EntraAgentIdentityBlueprints, EntraAgentIdentityBlueprintPrincipals, EntraAgentIdentities, EntraAgentUsers
Microsoft Learn: agentType values agenticApp, agentIdentityBlueprintPrincipal, agenticAppInstance, agentIDuser
blueprintId links an agent identity instance back to its blueprint template

nodes.label: AgentsInfo
nodes.description: Advanced hunting inventory table for AI agents across platforms (Copilot Studio, Foundry, Copilot, third-party, endpoint-discovered). Exposes declared guardrails, system prompt, permissions, tools, and an ObservabilityId correlation key.
evidence: Column Guardrails: guardrails attached to the agent and their coverage
Column Instructions: the agent's system prompt defining default behavior and operating boundaries
Column Permissions, DeclaredTools, McpServers, Capabilities: declared authZ/tool surface
Column ObservabilityId: correlates the agent with usage/activity data in Microsoft Agent 365
Replaces AIAgentsInfo; AIAgentsInfo is retired July 1, 2026 (Microsoft Learn, June 2026 naming change)

nodes.label: BehaviorInfo
nodes.description: Advanced hunting table of correlated behaviors from Defender for Cloud Apps and UEBA, pre-classified against MITRE ATT&CK, with an account join key and a bounded activity window.
evidence: Column Categories: threat/breach classification per MITRE ATT&CK
Column AttackTechniques: MITRE ATT&CK techniques tied to the behavior
Column AccountObjectId, StartTime, EndTime: same join key and time-bounding pattern as CAND-001
Preview table; requires Defender for Cloud Apps and UEBA to be deployed

nodes.label: UnifiedAgentObservability
nodes.description: Runtime activity telemetry for AI agents, reported to exist in the Sentinel data lake and to include prompts, tool invocations, and session/channel context, keyed by ObservabilityId.
evidence: Observed directly in tenant schema browser (Agent Observability system tables)
Community/GitHub sources describe InvokeAgent, InferenceCall, ExecuteToolByGateway, ExecuteToolBySDK, AISpanOutput event types
Not yet confirmed against a first-party Microsoft Learn schema reference; treat column names as unverified until checked in your tenant

nodes.label: AppDependencies (Application Insights)
nodes.description: OpenTelemetry GenAI agent spans (InvokeAgent, ExecuteTool, OutputMessages) exported by Copilot Studio, Foundry, or custom-instrumented agents into the dependencies/AppDependencies table. Distinct product plane from Defender Advanced Hunting; this is the same App* table family tracked by the tenant's Telemetry Health & Cost workbook.
evidence: Columns: operation_Id (shared per agent turn/trace), operation_ParentId (parent-child span linkage), customDimensions (gen_ai.* and microsoft.* keys)
customDimensions key gen_ai.conversation.id: threads multiple turns of one conversation
customDimensions key gen_ai.agent.id / gen_ai.agent.name: agent identity as seen by the instrumentation SDK
Log Analytics table name: AppDependencies

nodes.label: AppGenAIContent
nodes.description: Dedicated Application Insights table for generative AI content: prompts, model responses, system instructions, and tool call arguments/results, split out because this content is often sensitive (PII/PHI) and should be a protected table.
evidence: Routes gen_ai.input.messages, gen_ai.output.messages, gen_ai.system_instructions, gen_ai.tool.definitions, gen_ai.tool.call.arguments, gen_ai.tool.call.result
Before Sept 30 2026: also duplicated into AppDependencies/AppTraces/AppEvents; after that date, only a pointer remains in those tables
Log Analytics table name: AppGenAIContent

nodes.label: Confirmed bridge: App Insights spans to Entra Agent ID
nodes.description: Application Insights AppDependencies spans carry a customDimensions key, microsoft.a365.agent.blueprint.id, that Microsoft Learn documents as the agent identity blueprint's ID -- the same identifier space as EntraAgentIdentityBlueprints and AgentsInfo.EntraBlueprintId. This is a confirmed, documented join key across the two telemetry planes, not an assumption like the AccountObjectId/EntraAgentId join used elsewhere in this graph.
evidence: Microsoft Learn: 'Integrate agent observability using direct OTel' lists microsoft.a365.agent.blueprint.id as a run-wide span attribute
AgentsInfo.EntraBlueprintId: 'the unique identifier by Microsoft Entra ID for the agent identity blueprint'
gen_ai.conversation.id (AppDependencies) is a plausible secondary bridge to UnifiedAgentObservability/ObservabilityId, but that pairing is unverified

nodes.label: Guardrails field may fill the gatekeeper gap
nodes.description: The report explicitly says no gatekeeper decision field was confirmed. AgentsInfo.Guardrails documents guardrails attached to an agent and their coverage, which is a plausible first-party signal for exactly that gap and should be checked before accepting the account-and-time approximation as final.
evidence: Report gap: 'no explicit gatekeeper decision field was confirmed'
AgentsInfo.Guardrails: guardrails attached to the agent and their coverage
BehaviorInfo.Categories/AttackTechniques: pre-classified MITRE ATT&CK behaviors, stronger than raw AlertEvidence

nodes.label: CAND-002 guardrail-enriched correlation
nodes.description: Proposed enrichment that replaces the blind CloudAppEvents-to-AlertEvidence account join with an agent-aware correlation: identify agents with weak/absent guardrail coverage in AgentsInfo, then correlate their tool runs to MITRE-classified BehaviorInfo records for the same account.
evidence: Not present in the source report; proposed based on tenant-observed Agent Observability tables
Query: detections/CAND-002-guardrail-enriched.kql
Requires tenant validation before use; column names for UnifiedAgentObservability are unverified

nodes.label: SuspiciousPromptTerms
nodes.description: Tenant-specific prompt-safety bypass or prohibited-instruction terms.
evidence: Default: empty dynamic array
Empty default excludes nothing

nodes.label: CorrelationWindow
nodes.description: Maximum elapsed time between the AI tool run and downstream evidence.
evidence: Default: 4h
Shorter windows reduce unrelated joins

nodes.label: RequiredAlertCategories
nodes.description: Optional tenant-specific alert categories required for consequence corroboration.
evidence: Default: empty dynamic array
Empty default excludes nothing

nodes.label: CAND-001 correlation
nodes.description: Inner-joins completed AI tool runs to later alert evidence on AccountObjectId and bounded event ordering.
evidence: Methodology: correlation
Strategy: multi_table_correlation
Frequency: every hour
Query: detections/CAND-001.kql

nodes.label: 14-day replay
nodes.description: Historical replay across 336 consecutive one-hour windows measured rule volume.
evidence: Total hits: 0
Tenant median noise threshold: 2
Classification: not_noisy
Signal effectiveness is unproven because no positive events were observed

nodes.label: Readiness conflict
nodes.description: The report matrix says ready to deploy, while the query section says the rule is not deploy-ready until placeholders are filled.
evidence: Summary: 1 ready to deploy
Placeholder notice: not deploy-ready
Conservative resolved status: requires tuning

nodes.label: Known provenance gaps
nodes.description: The signal approximates bypass and can join unrelated actions for busy accounts.
evidence: No explicit gatekeeper decision field
Account-level correlation may be ambiguous
Lookback consistency warning: design 1h is smaller than largest rule window 5h

nodes.label: Query-surface mismatch
nodes.description: The source query uses Defender Advanced Hunting's Timestamp field, while the official Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics schemas expose TimeGenerated.
evidence: CloudAppEvents Log Analytics schema: TimeGenerated
AlertEvidence Log Analytics schema: TimeGenerated
Sentinel-adapted query: detections/CAND-001-sentinel.kql

nodes.label: Candidate alert
nodes.description: A low-severity investigation lead containing the account, AI run context, and downstream alert evidence.
evidence: Severity: Low
Requires analyst triage and tenant tuning

nodes.label: MITRE ATT&CK T1562
nodes.description: Impair Defenses, mapped by the report to the gatekeeper-evasion behavior.
evidence: Exact technique-ID coverage: 1 of 1
Kill-chain phase: Defense Evasion

edges.description: The report defines behavior cluster BC-1.
Gatekeeper evasion manifests as a disguised adversarial prompt.
The prompt is crafted to evade the policy-screening control.
The hypothesized bypass occurs before downstream tool execution.
Completed tool execution is observed in CloudAppEvents.
CloudAppEvents attributes the tool run to AccountObjectId.
Application and IP context describe the tool run.
AlertEvidence attributes downstream evidence to the same AccountObjectId.
The detection consumes completed AI tool runs.
The detection consumes downstream alert evidence.

CAND-001's actual join: a completed AI tool run and later alert evidence for the same account within a bounded window. There is no shared trace or session ID -- this is an identity-plus-time join, so unrelated activity for busy accounts can match.
edges.evidence: join kind=inner (AIToolRuns) on AccountObjectId; Timestamp between run and run+CorrelationWindow

edges.description: Prompt terms optionally focus InputParameters.
The time window bounds ordering after AIToolRunTimestamp.
edges.evidence: Timestamp between AI run and AI run + CorrelationWindow

edges.description: Alert categories optionally narrow downstream evidence.

Zero-hit validation supports low measured noise but does not prove efficacy.
Two report sections give incompatible deployment-readiness statements.
No confirmed telemetry records the gatekeeper decision.
Known assumptions and ambiguous joins limit confidence.
A matched correlation produces an investigation lead.
The report maps BC-1 to T1562.
Candidate alerts inherit the report's T1562 mapping.

BehaviorInfo has a native AccountObjectId column, so it can attribute records to an account -- but whether that account ID is the same identifier as this agent's EntraAgentId/entity-agent-identity is not confirmed by any schema reference found.

edges.description: CAND-002's proposed join: weakly-guarded agents (AgentsInfo) linked to MITRE-classified behaviors (BehaviorInfo) for the same account. Weaker than the CAND-001 join above -- it additionally assumes AgentsInfo.EntraAgentId and BehaviorInfo.AccountObjectId share an identifier space, which is unverified.
edges.evidence: agent-observability-preflight.kql query 5 checks this assumption; CorrelatedAccounts=0 would falsify it
